actions.name: 扶稳站姿髋外展：徒手至弹力带

frames.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: STEP 01 preparation of rehabilitation T-LOW-006 standing supported hip abduction. Reference images 1, 2, 3 strictly define the SAME recognizable adult East Asian woman, exact face/age/skin/build/black ponytail, fitted white short sleeve shirt, charcoal gray full-length pants, normal adult body proportions, soft photorealistic studio lighting and light cool gray-blue seamless background. Preserve all these exactly.
Scene: gray-blue seamless studio floor/background, only required solid fixed gray handrail to the woman's LEFT (viewer RIGHT). Real stable waist-high horizontal gray tubular handrail, about 85–90 cm high, mounted on two sturdy gray upright posts with broad base plates visibly anchored flat to floor. No chair, no moving prop, no elastic band. Simple white athletic shoes.
Pose: preparation, TRUE FRONT VIEW. Woman stands upright square toward camera, pelvis/torso facing directly forward and level, shoulders relaxed. Both legs almost straight, both shoes fully flat on floor, feet comfortably close about hip-width. LEFT hand (viewer right) rests/grips gently on fixed horizontal rail next to her hip, hand on rail clear. Right arm (viewer left) relaxed down by her right thigh. Right leg on viewer left is the designated TEST leg but remains fully planted for preparation. Left leg on viewer right will support and is planted. Normal calm face and forward gaze. Do not begin abduction yet, do not lift any leg.
Composition: 4:5 vertical full-body photograph about1122x1402, full ponytail/head, both complete hands, all fingers, both entire shoes and floor support contact visible with comfortable margins; reserve extra room on viewer LEFT for later lifting the right leg out sideways, but no cropping. Camera fixed front at midbody height with natural focal length and no distortion. Person height and fixed rail location should be suitable for locked-camera subsequent frame. One person, one stage. No text, numbers, arrows, collage, panels, ghost limbs or watermark. Natural proportions and joint continuity.
frames.pose_zh: 徒手正面站稳，左手扶固定灰扶手，双脚接地、躯干骨盆朝前。
frames.visual_review: 已目视检查：固定扶手双底座螺栓接地、扶持左手与两完整鞋接触清楚，人物/比例/服装/背景正确。

frames.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve precise pose edit. EDIT TARGET Image 4: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/train/steps/073_T-LOW-006_s01.png. Images 1–3 are original strict woman identity/clothing/style references. Produce STEP 02 of the SAME T-LOW-006 no-band fixed-handrail hip abduction sequence. LOCK all image 4 invariants exactly: same camera front view/position/focal length/framing/resolution, same woman face/body size/head position, same gray-blue light/background/floor shadows, same clothes/white shoes, same fixed gray handrail and both anchored floor posts at exact coordinates, same LEFT supporting hand (viewer right) on exact rail contact. SAME left support leg/foot on viewer right planted in exact position. Same right arm by thigh, shoulders and level pelvis facing forward.
Change ONLY her RIGHT TEST LEG on viewer LEFT: slowly abduct it out toward viewer LEFT, whole thigh/leg moving laterally from hip, knee almost straight, shoe lifted fully off floor, modest 20–25 degree outward angle. The hip stays at exactly same location, support leg does not move, pelvis remains level and torso upright without side-lean. Test shoe toes face forward, not crossed in front or externally turned. Correct natural unchanged leg length and proportions. Maintain all upper body/support/rail features locked so two frames can be compared from a fixed camera. One person one pose, no text/number/arrows/panels/ghost limbs.
frames.pose_zh: 左腿保持支撑，右测试腿向外侧（画面左侧）抬离地，躯干仍朝前。
frames.visual_review: 已目视检查：右腿外展且足离地，未跨前，左支撑脚原位、骨盆无明显侧倒，扶持与正常比例正确。

actions.group_review: 两图对照目视通过：同一正面机位、人物尺度、头/支撑脚/扶持手、扶手双固定底座位置、灰蓝背景光线一致；只改变右测试腿外展及自然随腿的非扶持手位置。

Both legs nearly straight and BOTH feet flat on floor underneath hips, shoes side by side; near-camera RIGHT leg/white shoe visibly distinct in front of far leg by natural camera perspective. Extra clear space on viewer LEFT behind her for later right leg backward extension; no body cropped or compressed. Solid fixed rail visible including anchored bases, its posts do not conceal support foot. One person one pose, NO text/numbers/arrows/panels/collage/ghost limbs/watermark. frames.visual_review: 已目视检查：侧面机位、固定灰扶手螺栓底座、扶持手和双足清楚，正常比例及原参考人物/服装/背景保持。

actions.name: 侧卧髋外展

frames.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: STEP01 preparation T-LOW-008 side-lying hip abduction, no band/no ankle weight. References1–3 strictly define SAME adult East Asian woman, exact recognizable face/black ponytail/skin/build/age, fitted white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal gray full-length trousers, healthy normal adult head/trunk/limb proportions, soft photorealistic studio light and light cool gray-blue background.
Scene: same seamless gray-blue studio floor/background, ONLY plain thin nonslip gray mat and small plain gray head pillow. White socks, NO shoes.
Pose: woman lying on her LEFT SIDE, head at LEFT of picture, feet toward RIGHT, chest facing camera, shoulders/pelvis stacked vertically without rolling backward. Head and neck comfortably resting ON small pillow, face calm looking slightly forward. Bottom LEFT leg bent comfortably about70–90degrees at knee, knee comes a little forward to support, thigh/knee/shin/foot all distinguishable and remain on mat. Top RIGHT TEST leg nearly straight extending naturally toward viewer RIGHT, lowered at resting starting height, NOT raised, resting lightly in alignment with trunk; its complete white-socked foot visible farther right than bottom foot. Natural continuous leg length. Upper RIGHT hand resting palm down on mat in FRONT of chest as light balance support, whole forearm/elbow/hand visible. Bottom LEFT arm rests on mat in front of pillow/head with elbow comfortably bent and hand visible beside pillow edge; no elbow/hand cropped and no hand hidden underneath pillow. Pillow directly supports head, she does not prop her head up on a hand.
Composition: true BODY SIDE medium-full view from front of her chest, fixed camera slightly above mat height with natural focal length. Vertical4:5 photo about1122x1402, complete body fits horizontally across LOWER MIDDLE of frame with calm gray-blue blank space above. Leave at least50px comfortable margin beyond leftmost head/pillow/arm and rightmost toes, whole mat and BOTH hands and BOTH socked feet fully visible. Pose is baseline for locked-camera subsequent top-leg raise. One person one stage; no text, numbers, arrows, collage, panels, ghost limbs or watermark. Natural adult anatomy without shortened legs, same reference style and color.
frames.pose_zh: 侧卧防滑垫，头颈枕支撑、底腿屈曲落垫、上侧腿舒适伸展放下。
frames.visual_review: 已目视检查修正版：头侧直接接触小灰枕、双手/下臂完整可见，底腿屈曲与上腿近直放下清楚，骨盆维持侧卧，比例与原人物服装/背景正确。
